description: Figure 2 presents a scatter plot illustrating the relationship between reported attribute weights and learned attribute weights. The horizontal axis, labeled “Learned Attribute Weights,” displays values ranging from 0 to 100 on a linear scale, with tick marks at intervals of 20, representing learned attribute weights. The vertical axis, labeled “Reported Attribute Weights,” also ranges from -100 to 100 on a linear scale, with tick marks at intervals of 20, representing reported attribute weights. Data points are plotted across the chart, with each point corresponding to an attribute; the points are colored purple. A trendline is overlaid on the data, indicated by a dashed line, and the R-squared value for the trendline is displayed as r = .51. The data points are generally clustered around the line y=x, with some points falling above and below it. The points are not sorted in any obvious order, and no points are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotation.
